description: Two IPv6 datagrams from 2001:db8:bad::1 whose 2048-byte Destination Options header does not fit in the 1232-byte first fragment, pushing the UDP header into the second (forbidden by RFC 7112). The first fragment is not under min_size, so the header-chain reason is what fires.

details.reason: IPv6 first fragment does not contain the whole header chain and upper-layer header (RFC 7112)
